name: manual_1c3b31
claim: git cherry marks squash-merged and rewritten-history commits as unmerged, so a long unmerged count proves nothing; compare trees instead: a branch whose merged tree equals the base adds nothing, and an older branch is only stale after a tree-level diff.
conditions: git cherry squash tree diff unmerged stale branches

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26 sweep: worktrees reported 367, 48 and 19 unmerged commits after squash merges and a main rewrite, while PR 522 merged with main to a tree identical to main.

rationale: 2026-11-26 sweep: worktrees reported 367, 48 and 19 unmerged commits after squash merges and a main rewrite, while PR 522 merged with main to a tree identical to main.
